description: Golden scenarios for the verification-agent eval harness. Each scenario constructs an issue + plan + execution result (diff summary) with an oracle label for the green verdict, plus labeled expectations for a subset of the routed domains' review criteria (matched case-insensitively by substring against the criterion text — only criteria with a definite answer are labeled). Scenarios with tests_passed=false exercise the deterministic short-circuit (no LLM call) and are reported separately from model-judged accuracy. Boundary cases (scope creep, partial coverage) are included deliberately — the harness exists to measure them.
